cohort: cohort.dev_v2 (adults, first visit, same-day serum urate and BMI, nitrite recovered, '<1.0' = 0.5, complete 12 inputs + urate, one record per person)
cohort_steps: persons with a first-visit urine test and a blood test within 14 days
aged 19 years or older at the urine test
serum urate measured on the urine-test day
BMI recorded on the urine-test day
all 9 dipstick fields and sex recorded (analytic cohort)
split: cohort.split_v2: person-level 80/20, stratified on urate bands <7, 7-<9, 9-<10, >=10; seed 42; shared by the three thresholds

search_spaces.LightGBM: n_estimators 100-300 step 50; max_depth 4-8; learning_rate 0.02-0.10 log; num_leaves 15-63; min_child_samples 10-100; reg_alpha 1e-3-1.0 log; reg_lambda 1e-3-1.0 log; random_state 42
search_spaces.XGBoost: n_estimators 100-300 step 50; max_depth 4-8; learning_rate 0.02-0.10 log; subsample 0.7-1.0; colsample_bytree 0.7-1.0; min_child_weight 1-10; random_state 42; eval_metric logloss
search_spaces.CatBoost: iterations 100-300 step 50; depth 4-8; learning_rate 0.02-0.10 log; l2_leaf_reg 1e-2-10 log; random_seed 42

recipe.calibration: CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic', cv=5) = StratifiedKFold(5) without shuffling on the training rows in split order
